# He runs right at the Yeti, which walks away, turns (299) and comes back. He jumps as it reaches him (310, yVel
# -4): on the way up his feet overlap its top and he's above it (other.y < y+5), JUMPING (state 15), so its
# collision counts a stomp. oPlayer1's step zeroes fallTimer on every step he isn't falling, so it takes
# ceil(0/16) = 0: stunned (status 98, 311), with all 5 hit points. He bounces off (yVel -5.22) unhurt. Another
# monster's stomp, floor(fallTimer/16)+1, would take 1.
